items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday injury board for Week 5, corroborated by Rapoport/Eagles report (hamstring); Tank Bigsby also OUT.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 4; final report confirmation.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee or backup elevated; heavy snap/carry loss for Barkley.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries/red-zone in PHI backfield (Shipley/Gainwell type).

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt/James); ETR lists OUT.
items.implication: LAC WR targets consolidate to McConkey (Q) or others; Herbert ceiling hit.
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey routes/targets if active; depth WRs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons (ankle); Rapoport and ETR confirm. Tyler Huntley to start.
items.why: Ankle sprain; no practice; coach confirmation.
items.implication: Ravens passing game downgrade; Flowers/Andrews limited upside under Huntley.
items.opportunity: Huntley rush/pass volume; Zay Flowers still startable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring); Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants. ETR lists Diggs OUT, Daniels IN.
items.why: Hamstring for Diggs; Daniels cleared to start.
items.implication: WAS WR targets to McLaurin (Q)/others; Daniels QB upgrade from backup.
items.opportunity: Terry McLaurin or secondary WRs if Diggs absent; full Daniels rushing/passing.

items.text: Broncos place WR Pat Bryant on IR; promoted Lil'Jordan Humphrey. Rapoport: short-term IR, miss ~4 games, returnable Nov 8.
items.why: Ankle injury from Week 4; short-term IR.
items.implication: DEN WR depth chart shuffle; targets to Sutton/others.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton or secondary WRs increased role.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (with Barkley/Hollywood Brown); Goedert IN. Schefter/Rapoport Eagles corroboration.
items.implication: PHI targets to Goedert/Wicks/others; Hurts checkdowns up.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell); final Sunday board.
items.implication: NYJ RB committee or backup lead; Hall zero.
items.opportunity: Backup RB carries/snaps in Jets backfield.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT on ETR board.
items.implication: IND WR targets to Downs/Pierce/Alec etc.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs or Alec Pierce increased routes/targets.

items.text: ETR massive Q list: Ja'Marr Chase/Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson/Addison, Ashton Jeanty, Caleb Williams, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Rhamondre, McLaurin, Kamara, etc. Levitan: ridiculous/messy Sunday morning expected.
items.implication: Monitor morning actives; high volatility for lineups.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries if any OUT (e.g. Meyers/Gesicki for CIN; backups for others).

items.text: Jeremiyah Love IN (not on final report) despite ankle maintenance; Levitan projects much bigger workload than Week 4, 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Gut says better role after usage criticism.
items.why: Not on final IR; media/fan drag on prior usage may boost role; maintenance only.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with elevated carries/snaps vs prior week drag.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back workload, goal-line, routes if Allgeier limited share.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle flares or committee persists.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk for Malik Nabers later season: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low post-half targets noted.
items.why: Sore knee (missed practice), shoulder, QB/coaching volatility, usage frustration.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential volatility ROS despite talent.
items.opportunity: Still high target share if healthy, but risk of reduced efficiency/snaps.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Nico Collins vs Titans, ranks WR8; volume + red-zone + matchup vs leaky secondary.
items.why: Target hog, red-zone usage, favorable matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; volume + Bengals injuries potential upside + soft run D. Pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/gobble ability.
items.why: Workload, matchup vs MIA, possible Chase/Higgins absence boost.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) on volume/matchup/coverage edges.
items.why: Target volume/RZ for Wilson; coverage/positional for Watson/Likely.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes in favorable spots; Likely with Lamar out.

Primary official OUTs/ACTIVES: Johnston out, Evans clear, Bryant IR, Bosa/Juszczyk out, Mykel Williams activate, Lamar/others. Essential status rulings.
